description: Phase 5: Employee Dashboard. Build applicant management interface for recruiters with list/filter/sort capabilities, Interview model for scheduling, interview scheduling flow from applicant view, notes and ratings on applicants, bulk actions (bulk reject, bulk shortlist), and CSV export of applicants.
steps: 1. Create Interview model in applications/models.py with FK to Application, scheduled_at DateTimeField, interview_type CharField choices (PHONE, VIDEO, IN_PERSON, TECHNICAL, HR), location TextField (for in-person or video link), notes TextField, rating IntegerField (1-5, nullable), interviewer FK to User, created_at, updated_at. Add index on scheduled_at and rating.
2. Update Application model to add fields: notes TextField (internal recruiter notes), rating IntegerField (1-5, nullable) for overall rating separate from interview ratings
3. Create InterviewForm in applications/forms.py with all fields, Bootstrap styling, date-time picker widget for scheduled_at
4. Create ApplicantFilterSet using django_filters for status, rating (range), date applied (range), job
5. Create admin for Interview model in applications/admin.py

6. Extend applications/services.py with methods: schedule_interview(application, interview_data, scheduled_by), update_interview(interview, data), add_applicant_note(application, note, user), rate_applicant(application, rating, user), bulk_change_status(application_ids, new_status, changed_by, note)

7. Create views in applications/views.py: ApplicantDetailView (EMPLOYEE only, shows full applicant profile, resume download, application, status change form, interview scheduling form, notes section, rating), ScheduleInterviewView (create interview), UpdateInterviewView (edit interview), UpdateApplicantStatusView (change status via service with note), AddApplicantNoteView (add internal note), RateApplicantView (set rating)
8. Create BulkActionView (EMPLOYEE only, handles bulk status changes from applicants list with checkboxes), ExportApplicantsCSVView (generates CSV of applicants for a job with all relevant fields)
9. Update JobApplicantsListView from FEAT-003 to include sorting (by date, rating), filtering (status, rating range), bulk action checkboxes, export CSV button

10. Create URL patterns in applications/urls.py: applicants/<int:pk>/ (detail), applicants/<int:pk>/schedule-interview/, applicants/<int:pk>/update-status/, applicants/<int:pk>/add-note/, applicants/<int:pk>/rate/, interviews/<int:pk>/edit/, jobs/<int:job_pk>/applicants/bulk-action/, jobs/<int:job_pk>/applicants/export/

11. Create templates: applicant_detail.html (tabbed interface with Overview, Resume, Application, Interviews, Notes, Actions), schedule_interview_form.html, applicant_notes.html (timeline of notes), bulk_action_confirm.html (confirm bulk status change)
12. Update applicants_list.html to add checkboxes for bulk selection, filter form, sort dropdown, export CSV button, rating display
13. Add JavaScript for bulk selection (select all checkbox, individual checkboxes) and bulk action modal
14. Create employee dashboard landing page at dashboard/views.py: EmployeeDashboardView showing summary stats (total applicants, pending, shortlisted, upcoming interviews) and recent activity
15. Create URL pattern dashboard/urls.py with app_name='dashboard': '' (employee dashboard)
16. Update config/urls.py to include dashboard.urls at 'employee/' prefix
17. Create template dashboard/employee_dashboard.html with stat cards and recent applicants table
18. Run makemigrations for Interview model and Application updates
19. Run migrate
20. Write tests for bulk actions, interview scheduling, permissions on applicant detail
acceptance_criteria: Interview model stores interview details with type, date, location, notes, rating
Applicant detail page shows full profile, resume download link, application details, interviews list, notes timeline, and actions (schedule interview, change status, add note, rate)
Recruiters can schedule interviews with date/time picker and type selection
Recruiters can add internal notes on applicants (not visible to applicants)
Recruiters can rate applicants (1-5 stars) both overall and per interview
Applicants list includes filters (status, rating range, date applied), sorting (date, rating, name), and pagination
Bulk actions: select multiple applicants via checkboxes and apply status change (e.g., bulk reject, bulk shortlist) with confirmation modal
Export CSV button generates downloadable CSV with applicant name, email, job, status, rating, applied date, resume link
Employee dashboard shows summary stats and recent activity
All recruiter views enforce permission checks (EMPLOYEE role, company ownership)
Tests cover bulk action logic, interview scheduling, and permission enforcement
verification: As recruiter: view applicants list for a job, verify filters and sorting work
Click on applicant, verify detail page shows profile, resume download, application
Schedule an interview, verify Interview record created
Add note on applicant, verify it appears in notes timeline
Rate applicant 4/5, verify rating saved and displayed
Select 2 applicants with checkboxes, choose 'Shortlist' bulk action, confirm, verify both status changed to SHORTLISTED
Export applicants to CSV, verify CSV downloads with correct data
Access employee dashboard, verify stats displayed
